endpoints.purpose: order with image URL (downloaded by Pictorem) + customer address

reference.limits: Not published. - PRO account - Key without payment method = quote mode (never billed)

fields.name: artflow_key
fields.help: Your ArtFlowKey, issued on request through your Pictorem account (can be a test-mode key).

me.note: getorderlist with limit 1: verifies the ArtFlowKey and shows the account's order count (data.total).

list_products.note: getartworklist: your own Pictorem artworks (name, keywords, categories, orientation, image set). Pictorem sells made-to-order prints: a sellable product is an artwork plus a preordercode (numCopies|material|type|orientation|width|height|options…, see the code builder) priced with getprice. `query`/`category` are not applied.

create_order.note: sendorder (multipart form). `items`: up to 5 lines in Pictorem form [{code: preordercode, fileurl + filetype (jpg/png/tiff) OR collectionID, bordercolorhex (when the code needs it), comment}]; `shipping_address`: {firstname, lastname, company?, address1, address2?, city, province (state code), country (ISO or name), cp (postal code), phone?, po? (your unique reference; makes retries safe), ordercomment?}. Without a getshippingquote quote the order is created with no shipping charge; `shipping_option` is not applied. Returns the Pictorem orderid.

get_order.note: getorderstatus by Pictorem order id: order_status (commercial: Processing, Shipped, Canceled…) and production_status (workshop stage, progress %), billing status, tracking, delivery and lines in raw.

track.note: getorderstatus: tracking_number/tracking_carrier once shipped (UPS), order and production status; per-line tracking under events (lines).

not_offered.get_product: There is no single-product endpoint: products are preordercodes validated with validatepreorder and priced with getprice (https://www.pictorem.com/artflow/0.1/docs/), and artworks are only listed in pages by getartworklist.
not_offered.quote_shipping: getshippingquote requires 'deliveryInfo[city] text *', 'deliveryInfo[province] text *' and 'deliveryInfo[cp] text *' plus the product code (https://www.pictorem.com/artflow/0.1/docs/); the vocabulary's quote_shipping has only product_id, country and quantity.

adapter.terms: ArtFlow API v0.1 (https://www.pictorem.com/artflow/0.1/docs/): every endpoint is HTTPS POST with multipart/form-data and the ArtFlowKey header; responses carry status true/false and msg.error[] (HTTP 422 on validation errors). A test-mode key or testmode=1 runs orders without creating them.

evidence: host www.pictorem.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
